modules.ot_qfd_band_lanes: r21m master qfd_sp_band_lanes: one band, NL lanes (16), tree levels 8..10 over the band 8 level-7 positions (7 FP32 adders LAT 7 a lane = 112), level holds, 20+2LNK-edge ring wait for the round trip, band-0 tree-top mux (b0 strap, one netlist for all 6 bands), pin flops on every input (sel/tv/b0/tt_use per-lane flop copies), stations on every output
modules.ot_qfd_band_upper: tree-top part: levels 11, 12 over the 6 band words (3 + 1 adders a lane = 64), c taps delayed DLY = 2 + LNK, use / valid carried to the station, lockstep valid check on the 6 band words
modules.ot_qfd_bt_levels: generic per-lane levels (ot_qwen_me_sptree_w12 g_lvl with HOLD_TO = GI)

rtl.frame: band-local result slots: split s <= 10: band b slot k = global group b*2^(10-s)+k (k < 2^(10-s)); s = 11/12: band 0 slot k = group k (k < 6144>>s); s = 13: none (as the lane). s = 7 is the lane frame (8b+k). Out-of-range slots are don't-care, as the lane's out-of-range positions.
rtl.link: band <-> tree top: words + VALID through registered pin stations; no credits (both ends are fixed-latency, never-stalling pipelines: a credit counter would be a constant); receivers check the arriving valid against their own (lockstep) and fault on mismatch
rtl.contract: sel/tv per level are split-derived (monotone over levels for a valid op), as ot_qwen_me_spctl_w12 / ot_qwen_spine_lane_credit generate them
rtl.cycles_added: +5 + 2*LNK edges on every ME op result vs the monolithic lane (pw station, tree-top pin flop, tree-top station, band-0 pin flop, ty station; LNK relay stages each way). Recorded, not priced (directive).

bench.method: 6 band blocks + upper with LNK relays vs NL copies of ot_qwen_spine_lane (TREE_LAT 7) on the same words and split-derived sel/tv (ot_qwen_spine_lane_credit generation); random FP32 words with exponents 112..143 (reassociation changes rounding), random splits 7..13, valid gaps + back-to-back runs; every in-range group of every valid op compared bit-exact; fault: finite phase 0/0, NaN in a split-12 op 1/1
